description: Cross-language golden vectors for SQDP-1 / @splendor/pq-bridge. Signature scheme: ML-DSA-65 (NIST FIPS 204). TS Vitest and Go TestDeriveFromSeedStable must stay aligned on domain message + minFee; seed→address pair is locked by WASM session tests (rebuild sqc_signer.wasm from the Go signer after the ML-DSA migration). permit/order pin the off-chain authorisation digests (core/types PermitDigest / OrderDigest / CancelDigest / IncrementNonceDigest) for every other implementation; their fromGoldenSeed values are what sqSignPermit / sqSignOrder / sqSignCancel / sqSignIncrementNonce report from the seed session with the same inputs (Go: signer.TestGoldenVectorsFilePinsDigests).
domainMessage:
Splendor Quantum Chain
Key derivation v1
chain: splendor-quantum-1

permit.description: qrc20.permit digest = SHA3-256("qrc20:permit:v2:" || u16be(len(chainId)) || chainId || contract[32] || owner[32] || spender[32] || amount[32 BE] || nonce[8 BE] || deadline[8 BE]), signed under context. Go: core/types/permit_test.go TestPermitDigestGolden.

fromGoldenSeed.description: sqSignPermit({token: contract, spender, amount, nonce, deadline}) from the seedHex session (owner = address) reports this digest_hex.

order.description: exchange order hash = SHA3-256("exchange:order:v1:" || u16be(len(chainId)) || chainId || exchange[32] || salt[32] || maker[32] || condition[8 BE] || outcome[1] || side[1] || share_amount[32 BE] || price[32 BE] || expiration[8 BE] || nonce[8 BE] || recipient[32]); cancelDigest = SHA3-256("exchange:cancel:v1:" || hash); incrementNonceDigest = SHA3-256("exchange:nonce:v1:" || u16be(len(chainId)) || chainId || exchange[32] || maker[32] || nonce[8 BE]). All signed under context. Go: core/types/order_test.go.

fromGoldenSeed.description: From the seedHex session (maker = address) with the same exchange/salt/condition/outcome/side/share_amount/price/expiration/nonce/recipient: sqSignOrder reports hash; sqSignCancel reports digest_hex = cancelDigestHex; sqSignIncrementNonce({exchange, expected_nonce: nonce}) reports digest_hex = incrementNonceDigestHex.
